vv24:4.1: Uposathā ti maṃ aññiṃsu Sāketāyaṃ upāsikā saddhā sīlena sampannā saṃvibhāgaratā sadā. || ||
vv24:5.1: Acchādanañ ca bhattañ ca senāsanaṃ padīpiyaṃ adāsiṃ ujubhūtesu vippasannena cetasā. || ||
vv24:6.1: Cātuddasiṃ pañcadasiṃ yā ca pakkhassa aṭṭhamī pāṭihāriyapakkhañ ca aṭṭhaṅgasusamāgataṃ
vv24:8.1: Pāṇātipātā viratā musāvādā ca saññatā theyyā ca aticārā ca majjapānā ca ārakā || ||
vv24:9.1: Pañcasikkhāpade ratā ariyasaccāna kovidā upāsikā cakkhumato Gotamassa yasassino.
vv24:11.1: Abhikkhaṇaṃ Nandanaṃ sutvā chando me upapajjatha tattha cittaṃ paṇidhāya upapanna 'mhi Nandanaṃ. || ||
vv24:12.1: Nākāsiṃ satthu vacanaṃ buddhass' ādiccabandhuno hīne cittaṃ paṇidhāya sāmhi pacchānutāpinī. || || Kīva
vv24:13.1: ciraṃ vimānasmiṃ idha vassas' Uposathe devate pucchitācikkha yadi jānāsi āyuno. || || Saṭṭhivassasahassāni
vv24:14.1: tisso ca vassakoṭiyo idha ṭhatvā mahāmuni ito cutā gamissāmi manussānaṃ sahavyatanti. || ||
vv24:15.1: Mā tvaṃ Uposathe bhāyi sambuddhenāsi vyākatā sotāpannā visesayi pahīnā tava duggatī ti. || ||
